subject: Encord & [COMPANY] - ML DataOps for UAS Models
text:
Hi [NAME],

[COMPANY]'s name came up during a conversation we had with Steve Simoni at
Allen Control Systems during our Physical AI event last week in SF, so
wanted to reach out to see if you'd be open to a quick chat?

We've recently started working on projects with a bunch of your unmanned
systems peers (i.e. Controp, Skydio, Airis, ACS...) to support the fine
tuning of their drone detection computer vision models with the goal of
speeding up expansion into new use cases - particularly focused on agentic
workflows to automate their annotation pipeline as their requirements grow
in complexity and scale.

Bit of context on Encord…we're a computer vision scale-up (Series B, $50M
raised) focused on consolidating data curation, annotation, and model
evaluation in one platform.

Would you be open to a quick virtual coffee with our leadership team in the
coming weeks? It'd be great to introduce ourselves & get your feedback on
what we're building. We're pretty open Friday afternoon PT, however happy
to work around your schedule!

subject: Working w/ Baker Hughes & Boeing | Computer Vision @ GE
text:
Hi [NAME]​, 

I just saw your work on computer vision at GE, and thought I'd reach out. I lead a manufacturing & energy computet vision team here at Encord (~6 years old, 100+ employees & $50M+ funding) and we're working with a few of your peers (Baker Hughes, Toyota, Bosch, Siemens, Boeing, etc) to expand into new AI/CV products & scale use cases like automated visual asset inspection, AI-guided borescope inspections, predictive maintenance, quality control in manufacturing, and robotics navigation.

Keen to trade notes & get your thoughts on what we're building if you're be open to a 30-minute chat this week or the next? Wednesdays and Thursdays usually work for me.

subject: ADAS data curation - virtual coffee?
text:

out. We work w/ autonomous driving teams at Woven by Toyota, Wayve, Oxa,
etc, helping them better manage their training datasets.

searching through billions of data items (using embeddings visualisations,
quality metric filters & natural language searches), enabling CV teams to
avoid bottlenecks in model development.

It'd be great to say hi, learn more about what you're working on & share
the highlights from the Physical AI webinar). Let me know if AM Thursday or
Friday work for a quick virtual coffee?
